activities.name: Circle Gifts
activities.description: Login event. Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

activities.name: City Logistics
activities.description: Limited-time event. Complete limited-time quests to earn the event currency "Kool" tokens, and finish all limited-time quests to claim the namecard "Big Dreams". Spend Kool tokens in the Event Shop to redeem the vehicle "C001", the title "Hethereau Delivery King", the phone case "Five-Star Reviews", the avatar "Kool", Fabricated Dice, and more. Raise your Reputation Level to earn additional rewards.

activities.name: Hunter's Crucible: Breakthrough
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, clear challenge stages to earn rewards, including the event title "Hunter's Crucible - Blade Honed", Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, and Chaotic Dye.

activities.name: Fortune's Bounty
activities.description: Limited-time event. Take part to earn "Fortune Coins" and reach progress milestones to claim rewards including the open-world interactable item "Pop-Up Divination House", the accessory "Tiny Friend", the tire tracks "Hyperflame", Solid Dice, Fabricated Dice, and more.

activities.name: Circle Bounty
activities.description: Version 1.5 Circle Bounty. During the event, complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points and raise your Circle Bounty Rank, unlocking Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, Eternal Shell Song, Development EXP Selection Box I, Expansion Core, and more.

activities.name: Open Roads Ahead
activities.description: Limited-time Mystery Box event. Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Open Roads Ahead" Mystery Boxes, with 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool. Contents include the vehicles "Iron Ogre" and "Prototype Land Overlord 001", the livery "Caution: Graffiti!", the avatar frame "Wayfinder", the namecard "The Open Road", Fabricated Dice, and more.

activities.name: Pixel Surge
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, spend Character Pixels in "Houdinii's Magic Stage", "Houdinii's Schemes", "Bubble Can Factory", and "Rabbit Hole" to receive double the rewards. Each day, double rewards apply to up to 120 Character Pixels spent. Unused daily allowance carries over, up to a total cap of 840 Character Pixels for the whole event.

activities.name: Full Tank Ahead
activities.description: Limited-time event. A special launch event for the TerraX "Iron Ogre". Take the wheel and fight to be king of the hill! Earn the event currency "TX Token" and redeem it in the Event Shop for Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

activities.name: Fishing Frenzy
activities.description: Limited-time event. Head to the "Sea Angler" fishing spot at Nacupeda Park and raise your fishing level for rewards including Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

activities.name: Gold Clash
activities.description: Limited-time event. During the event, earn Fons at 2x efficiency in "Pink Paws Heist".
